title: Three Travelers at Sunset
description: Three robed figures with their backs to the viewer walk along a dirt path through a grassy hillside. The central bearded figure holds a tall wooden staff with a spear-like tip, flanked by two hooded companions each carrying smaller staffs, all heading toward a bright sun setting over distant mountains.
